info.name: CatalogManager API Tests - Automated QA1 Copy
info.description:
Self-contained collection run: Categories -> Stores -> Products -> Cleanup. Run all folders in order with one iteration. Requires local HTTPS CatalogManager server. Main CRUD requests use generated IDs; negative requests assert expected 400/409 statuses.
B1: pagination checks for categories, stores, products (skip/limit/nextLink), plus backward compatibility.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const obj = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("categoryId",obj.id); pm.test("Category ID saved",()=>pm.expect(obj.id).to.be.a("number")); }
pm.test("Get Category By Id: HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("Create Second Category (Duplicate Update Setup): HTTP 201", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test("Invalid Category Name (Too Long): HTTP 400", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test("Invalid Category Name (Duplicate Update): HTTP 409", () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const obj = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("storeId", obj.id); pm.test("Store ID saved",()=>pm.expect(obj.id).to.be.a("number")); }
pm.test("Get Store By Id: HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const obj = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("productId",obj.id); pm.test("Product ID saved",()=>pm.expect(obj.id).to.be.a("number")); }
pm.test("Get Product By Id: HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
